<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script/><description/><direct>false</direct><endpoint>x_587457_pear_Applicative Access Preview - Dynamic v2.do</endpoint><html><j:jelly xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide">
  <div id="pear-aa-container">
    <h4>Applicative Access (Dynamic Preview by Business Profile)</h4>
    <button id="pear-aa-refresh" type="button">Refresh</button>
    <div id="pear-aa-loading" style="display:none;">Loading...</div>
    <table id="pear-aa-table" class="table table-bordered table-striped table-sm" style="display:none;">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>App access ID</th>
          <th>App access</th>
          <th>Business Profile ID</th>
          <th>Business Profile</th>
          <th>App ID</th>
          <th>Application</th>
          <th>Business Part ID</th>
          <th>Business Part</th>
          <th>Project Space ID</th>
          <th>Project</th>
          <th>Technical Role ID</th>
          <th>Technical Role</th>
          <th>Access Profile ID</th>
          <th>Access Profile</th>
          <th>License ID</th>
          <th>License</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="pear-aa-body"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <script>
  //<![CDATA[
    window.refreshAAPreview = function() {
      var loading = document.getElementById('pear-aa-loading');
      var table   = document.getElementById('pear-aa-table');
      var body    = document.getElementById('pear-aa-body');

      var rowsJSON = '[]';
      try { rowsJSON = g_form.getValue('pear_mrvs') || '[]'; } catch(e) {}

      loading.style.display = 'block';
      table.style.display   = 'none';
      body.innerHTML = '';

      var ga = new GlideAjax('x_587457_pear.PEAR_PreviewAPI'); // se scoped: 'x_587457_pear.PEAR_PreviewAPI'
      ga.addParam('sysparm_name','getApplicativeAccessByBp');
      ga.addParam('sysparm_rowsJson', rowsJSON);
      ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer){
        loading.style.display = 'none';
        var data = [];
        try { data = JSON.parse(answer || '[]'); } catch(e) {}
        data.forEach(function(row){
          var tr = document.createElement('tr');
          ['number','label','business_profile_id','business_profile','app_id','application','business_part_id','business_part','project_space_id','project','technical_role_id','technical_role','access_profile_id','access_profile','license_id','license'].forEach(function(f){
            var td = document.createElement('td');
            td.textContent = row[f] || '';
            tr.appendChild(td);
          });
          body.appendChild(tr);
        });
        table.style.display = 'table';
      });
    };

    // primo render e bottone refresh
    addLoadEvent(function(){
      if (typeof window.refreshAAPreview === 'function') window.refreshAAPreview();
      var btn = document.getElementById('pear-aa-refresh');
      if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', window.refreshAAPreview);
    });
  //]]>
  </script>
</j:jelly>
